cardPool.title: Aetherion
cardPool.value:
{Name: Aetherion.

Description: The continent of Aetherion is a vast, ancient land where six great kingdoms, each shaped by very different peoples, coexist. At its center lies Valerion, the human kingdom, made up of fortified cities, merchant kingdoms, and ambitious knights seeking to expand their influence. To the east stretch the eternal forests of Sylvariel, the elven realm, where magic and nature live in perfect harmony. To the south burns Inferkar, the domain of demons, a volcanic territory ruled by powerful and cunning lords. In the floating skies above the sacred mountains lies Luminara, the angelic realm, a civilization of light dedicated to balance and justice. In the wild north reigns Tharok, the kingdom of beastmen, made up of proud, warlike tribes living according to the laws of nature. Finally, beneath the western mountain ranges lies Khazdrim, the dwarven kingdom, renowned for its subterranean citadels, legendary forges, and mineral wealth.}

Drakarym
cardPool.value:
{Name: Drakarym.

Description: The Drakarym Range is a vast barrier of jagged, black mountains that cuts through a remote part of Aetherion, where storms rage almost year-round. Its peaks, often shrouded in storm clouds and volcanic smoke, shelter the lairs of the world's oldest dragons. In fire-scorched cliffs and gigantic caverns carved over millennia, the dragons guard their treasures and territories. Each peak of Drakarym is considered the domain of an ancient dragon, and no mortal dares venture there without risking awakening a creature capable of setting entire armies ablaze. Legends say that at the heart of the range lies the Throne of Ash, a sacred mountain where the oldest dragons gather to decide the fate of their kind when the world of Aetherion is threatened.}

cardPool.title: Aether
cardPool.value:
{Name: Aether.

Description: In the world of Aetherion, magic is an ancient force called Aether, an invisible energy that flows through nature, living beings, and even spirit realms. Some races, like the elves of Sylvariel or the angels of Luminara, are naturally connected to it and can wield it with great mastery, while humans must study it in academies or forge pacts to understand its secrets. Magic can take many forms: manipulating the elements, healing, enchanting objects, summoning spirits, or even altering reality. However, Aether is a capricious power that demands balance and discipline, for excessive or corrupted use can tear the veil between worlds, drawing in dangerous forces from Elyndra, Necethra, or the depths of Inferkar.}

cardPool.title: Primordial Elements
cardPool.value:
{Name: Primordial Elements.

Description: In the world of Aetherion, magic is divided into eight primordial elements that represent the fundamental forces of the universe. Fire embodies destruction, passion, and raw power, capable of reducing armies to ashes. Water symbolizes adaptation, healing, and the flow of life, controlling the seas, rain, and currents. Earth represents stability and strength, allowing control over stone, metal, and mountains. Wind is the element of freedom and speed, linked to storms, the air, and swift movement. Light is the sacred magic of protection, healing, and truth, often used by celestial beings. Darkness embodies shadows, illusions, and hidden forces—a magic as dangerous as it is mysterious. Time is an extremely rare element that allows influence over the past, present, or future, but its use can shatter the balance of the world. Finally, Space is the most enigmatic magic, capable of bending distances and manipulating the very structure of reality.}

cardPool.title: Pact Magic
cardPool.value:
{Name: Pact Magic.

Description: In the world of Aetherion, some humans practice a forbidden form of magic called pact magic, which involves forging a contract with a spirit of Elyndra or a daemon of Inferkar to borrow a portion of their power. This pact is sealed through an ancient ritual where the mage's soul, will, or a precious memory often serves as the price. Spirits typically grant powers tied to nature, dreams, or the elements, while daemons offer more destructive and dangerous abilities, such as hellfire, corruption, or shadow manipulation. However, these pacts are never entirely safe: the greater the power wielded, the more the contracted entity can influence the mage's mind or fate, and some pact-makers end up becoming servants—or even vessels—of the forces they have dealt with.}

cardPool.title: Summoning Magic
cardPool.value:
{Name: Summoning Magic.

Description: In the world of Aetherion, familiar summoning magic is a mystical art that allows a mage to forge a spiritual bond with a creature from another plane or magical dimension. Through an ancient ritual and a summoning seal, the mage calls upon a familiar—which can be a small animal spirit, an elemental creature, or even a rarer, more powerful entity. Once the pact is established, the familiar becomes a soul-bound companion to its summoner, sometimes sharing their senses, emotions, or a portion of their magic. Some familiars serve as scouts or messengers, while others can fight, protect their master, or amplify their powers. However, this bond is deep and fragile: if the familiar is gravely injured or destroyed, the summoner can feel the pain of the broken connection, and in the most extreme cases, a part of their own mind can be affected.}

cardPool.title: Personal Magic
cardPool.value:
{Name: Personal Magic.

Description: In the world of Aetherion, personal magic is a rare and mysterious form of power that arises directly from an individual's soul. Unlike other types of magic that are learned or passed down, this magic is unique to each person and reflects their inner nature, emotions, destiny, or life experiences. It can take many different forms: some can materialize their thoughts, others manipulate invisible threads of fate, control an element in a way never before seen, or create entirely unknown powers. This magic often manifests during an intense moment—danger, revelation, or spiritual awakening—and can evolve over time as the person matures. Because it follows no known rules, personal magic is both the most unpredictable and sometimes the most powerful of all the magic in Aetherion.}

Above them are the Eight Great Spirit Kings, each sovereign of a primordial element. These spirits are colossal entities whose existence influences the balance of the world itself.} At the summit of all reigns Aethernox, the King of Spirits, a primordial entity born with the Aether itself, guardian of the balance between all the elements and arbiter of conflicts between spirits.}

{Name: Pact Mages .

Description: Pact mages of Aetherion are mages who draw their power from a magical contract made with a powerful entity, such as a spirit of Elyndra, a daemon of Inferkar, or sometimes an ancient creature. Rather than learning magic solely through study, they acquire their abilities in exchange for a price: life energy, service, memories, or a portion of their soul. Physically, pact mages often bear mystical marks or seals left by the entity with whom they made their contract. They sometimes use talismans, rings, or engraved symbols that represent their pact and serve as a link to their power.}

cardPool.title: Archmages
cardPool.value:
{Name: Archmages.

Description: The Archmages of Aetherion are the most powerful and learned mages in the world, having achieved exceptional mastery of the Aether after decades, sometimes centuries, of study and practice. They understand the profound laws of magic and can manipulate multiple elements, create extremely complex spells, or influence magical phenomena on a grand scale. Archmages are rare and often respected, even feared, by the realms. Physically, an archmage may appear similar to an ordinary mage, but their magical aura is often perceptible to those who sense the Aether. Many wear ancient robes, carry powerful artifacts, or unique grimoires containing their own magical discoveries.}

cardPool.title: Lyra Stormblade (S-rank Adventurers)
cardPool.value:
{Characteristics:
Name: Lyra Stormblade.
Age: 46.
Race: Vampire.
Gender: Female
Status: Alive.

Professional Status:
Affiliation: Adventurers' Guild.
Occupation: S-rank Adventurers.

Appearance:
Lyra has long, red hair and striking blue eyes. She wears light armor reinforced for exploration and wields an enchanted sword capable of unleashing lightning bolts, a symbol of her many battles.

Personality:
Courageous, determined, and independent, Lyra never backs down in the face of danger. She possesses a strong sense of justice and often protects the weak, even when the mission doesn't require it. Known for defeating formidable monsters and exploring treacherous ancient ruins, she travels across the continent undertaking missions few dare to accept.}

cardPool.title: Merchants' Guild
cardPool.value:
{Name: Merchants' Guild.
Leader: Darius Goldhaven.
Number Of Member: +2000

Description: The Merchants' Guild of Aetherion is a major trading organization that connects the kingdoms of the continent through commerce, trade routes, and the exchange of wealth. It comprises merchants, artisans, caravans, and ship captains who transport goods between cities and kingdoms. Thanks to its influence, the guild plays a significant role in the economy and can even influence certain political decisions. Guild members often travel in caravans protected by guards or adventurers, carrying valuable goods such as dwarven metals from Khazdrim, magical wood from Sylvariel, or ancient artifacts. Major cities often have a Guild House, where merchants negotiate, organize trade routes, and record contracts.}

cardPool.title: Darius Goldhaven (Head Of Merchants' Guild)
cardPool.value:
{Characteristics:
Name: Darius Goldhaven.
Age: 38.
Race: Human.
Gender: Male
Status: Alive.

Professional Status:
Affiliation: Merchants' Guild.
Occupation: Head Of The Merchants' Guild.

Appearance:
Darius is an elegant man with neatly styled brown hair and watchful eyes. He wears rich yet practical clothing, adorned with rings and a golden medallion bearing the guild's emblem.

Personality:
Intelligent, diplomatic, and highly strategic, Darius knows how to negotiate with kings, adventurers, and merchants. He always prioritizes advantageous agreements while protecting the reputation and prosperity of his guild. Through his network of caravans, ships, and trading posts, he oversees a large portion of the trade between the kingdoms.}

cardPool.title: Black Guild
cardPool.value:
{Name: Black Guild.
Leader: Unknown.
Number Of Member: Unknown.

Description: The Black Guild of Aetherion is a secret organization operating in the shadows of the realms. Unlike official guilds, it comprises assassins, spies, thieves, and mercenaries specializing in illegal or dangerous missions. Few know its true workings, as the guild operates through hidden networks and intermediaries. Its members often work in major cities, ports, or underground cities, where they control the black market, secret information, and certain clandestine contracts. Missions entrusted to the Black Guild can range from espionage and the theft of artifacts to the elimination of high-value targets. Members frequently utilize secret symbols, codes, and hidden hideouts. Black Guild members are generally discreet, cunning, and extremely skilled in their respective fields.}

cardPool.title: Aetherism
cardPool.value:
{Name: Aetherism.
Leader: Solmarius.
Number Of Member: 100 000 000.

Description: Aetherism is the great religion of Aetherion, founded on the belief that all existence originates from the Aether, the primordial energy created by the goddess Aelyndra. According to this faith, the Aether flows through the world, the elements, spirits, and even the souls of living beings. Followers believe that maintaining the balance between the world's forces—light and darkness, life and death, creation and destruction—is the key to universal harmony. Temples of Aetherism are often built in places where magic is strong: sacred mountains, ancient forests, or great cities. Priests and priestesses teach that the Eight Great Spirit Kings represent the elemental manifestations of the Aether, while Aelyndra is worshipped as the creator and guardian of the world. Followers of this religion practice rituals, prayers, and pilgrimages to draw closer to the Aether.}

cardPool.title: Adventurers' Guild
cardPool.value:
{Name: Adventurers' Guild.
Leader: Ragnar Valdric.
Number Of Member: 5 000.

Description: The Adventurers' Guild of Aetherion is a renowned organization in many cities and kingdoms, tasked with gathering adventurers and assigning them missions. It acts as an intermediary between the inhabitants, the kingdoms, and those seeking individuals capable of facing the world's dangers: monsters, ancient ruins, bandits, or magical phenomena. Each major city has a Guild House, where missions are posted on bulletin boards and where adventurers can register, receive a rank, and form parties. Ranks generally range from novices to elite adventurers like the famous S, SS, or SSS ranks, capable of confronting major threats. The guild also serves as a meeting place, information exchange hub, and training center for adventurers. It enforces certain rules to prevent chaos among its members.}

cardPool.title: Ragnar Valdric (Leader Of Adventurers' Guild)

Appearance:
Ragnar is a robust man with graying hair and a short beard. His body bears many battle scars. He wears simple adventurer's armor and always keeps a greatsword at his side.

Personality:
Ragnar is straightforward, courageous, and respected by adventurers. He values ​​honor, solidarity, and responsibility, often reminding them that an adventurer's true strength lies in protecting others.  A former SS-rank adventurer, he traveled the continent and vanquished many threats before taking the helm of the guild to guide the next generation.}

cardPool.title: Mages Guild
cardPool.value:
{Name: Mages Guild.
Leader: Arcanis Velarya.
Number Of Member: 10 000.

Description: The Mages Guild of Aetherion is a large organization dedicated to the study, control, and transmission of magic. It unites mages from many backgrounds—scholars, researchers, teachers, and practitioners—to advance knowledge of the Aether and prevent magic from being used dangerously or unchecked. Mages guilds often possess large arcane towers, vast libraries, and laboratories housing grimoires, artifacts, and ancient knowledge. They also serve as academies where apprentice mages learn to master the elements, invocations, and other forms of magic. Guild members are generally very devoted to magical knowledge and discipline.}

cardPool.title: Arcanis Velarya (Leader Of Mages Guild)
cardPool.value:
{Characteristics:
Name: Arcanis Velarya.
Age: 650.
Race: Elf.
Gender: Female
Status: Alive.

Professional Status:
Affiliation: Mages Guild.
Occupation: Leader Of The Mages Guild.

Appearance:
Velarya has long silver hair and violet eyes that glow with magical energy. She wears an archmage's robe covered in ancient runes and often carries a crystal staff that amplifies her magic.

Personality:
Calm, brilliant, and highly disciplined, Velarya values ​​wisdom and knowledge. She protects the secrets of magic and acts decisively when dangerous forces threaten the balance of the Aether. Renowned for her exceptional mastery of the Aether, she oversees the study of magic, the training of mages, and the protection of arcane knowledge.}
